title: PayView
tagline: Web3 Monetized video platform built on FEVM, Which gives more power to creator instead of a big platform
description:
Our project Called "PayView" We have tried to build a platform Where Creators will upload their content(say Podcast or a course), We will ask for charge to view video from creator at the time of uploading, And If user want to view that video, User must pay the amount that creator has set and if pay is Successfull, We will mint an ERC721 token to User address and the address which have same token can view that. 

Also, For storing video on IPFS, Platform will store money paid by user and use it for the storage of next month, If money will be extra only then, paid to creator
how_its_made:
This Project uses FEVM to deploy our smart contract and uses IPFS to store video.
We have used Next framework for Frontend, ether js for reading data from blockchain.
We have written smart contract in solidity and have used Hardhat for deployment.
We have used Rainbow kit to connect Wallet,
Have used Hyperspace network to test smart contract
